displayName: STS2 loader: Cloud Function errors or rejected deliveries

documentation.content: The sts2-load-run Cloud Function logged an error, or Eventarc deliveries were rejected (e.g. missing run.invoker). Runs uploaded to GCS may not have loaded into BigQuery. Check: gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="sts2-load-run"' --freshness=1d. The loader is idempotent per run_id, so fixing the cause and re-uploading the affected .run files is safe.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="sts2-load-run" AND (severity>=ERROR OR textPayload:"was not authenticated")
